headline: Base Fighting Shifts Across Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows the heaviest base movement concentrated on several divided fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest recorded sector, with 59 events in 24 hours and 13 in the latest six, its holdings six Warden to three Colonial. Stonecradle has climbed to 27 daily events, including five in the latest two hours and 19 in six, while its nine bases stand three Warden to six Colonial. Stlican Shelf has logged 50 events across the day and eight in six hours, though none in the latest two; seven of its nine bases are Warden-held. Linn Mercy records 20 daily events, two in the latest two hours, with one Warden, nine Colonial and one neutral base. Godcrofts is active at the latest cutoff, posting three events in two hours and 16 in 24, with four bases held by each faction and one neutral. Fisherman’s Row has become a sharp current contact, recording six events in two hours and 13 across the day; its split is five Colonial to four Warden. Farranac Coast remains contested but has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window, while Callahan’s Passage reports severe casualties without recent base events.
